markets.question: Kansas Senate Election: Leavenworth County Winner
markets.description:
This market will settle to Yes if the Democratic Party nominee receives the most valid votes of any candidate in Leavenworth County in the 2026 Kansas Senate election. Outcome sourced from the Government of Kansas.

Vote totals will be inclusive of all valid votes cast in Leavenworth County, as reflected in the certified results from the Government of Kansas. If multiple candidates tie for the most votes in Leavenworth County, Yes contract holders for each tied candidate receive $1.00 divided by the number of tied candidates, rounded down to the nearest tick, per contract.

For full rules, see: https://www.polymarketexchange.com/files/products/PMUS%20-%20PVWC%20-%20(2026.07.14).pdf

If Brandon Cisse ties with one or more other players for the award Yes contract holders receive $1.00 divided by the number of tied players, rounded down to the nearest cent, per contract.
markets.title: Brandon Cisse
